sources.snippet: Whisper-Small Transformer‑based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for multilingual transcription and translation available on HuggingFace. HuggingFace Whisper‑Small ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) model is a state‑of‑the‑art system designed for transcribing spoken language into written text.
